import unittest

from solution import merge_profile


class MergeProfileTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_adds_and_replaces_without_mutation(self):
        profile = {"name": "Ada", "settings": {"theme": "light"}}
        updates = {"settings": {"theme": "dark"}, "active": True}
        result = merge_profile(profile, updates)
        self.assertEqual(result, {"name": "Ada", "settings": {"theme": "dark"}, "active": True})
        self.assertEqual(profile, {"name": "Ada", "settings": {"theme": "light"}})
        self.assertEqual(updates, {"settings": {"theme": "dark"}, "active": True})

    def test_empty_updates_still_deep_copy(self):
        profile = {"nested": [{"values": [1, 2]}]}
        result = merge_profile(profile, {})
        self.assertEqual(result, profile)
        self.assertIsNot(result, profile)
        self.assertIsNot(result["nested"], profile["nested"])
        self.assertIsNot(result["nested"][0], profile["nested"][0])
        self.assertIsNot(result["nested"][0]["values"], profile["nested"][0]["values"])
        result["nested"][0]["values"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(profile["nested"][0]["values"], [1, 2])

    def test_update_values_are_deeply_independent(self):
        profile = {"kept": {"items": [1]}}
        updates = {"new": ({"items": [2]},), "kept": {"items": [3]}}
        result = merge_profile(profile, updates)
        self.assertIsNot(result["kept"], updates["kept"])
        self.assertIsNot(result["kept"]["items"], updates["kept"]["items"])
        self.assertIsNot(result["new"][0], updates["new"][0])
        self.assertIsNot(result["new"][0]["items"], updates["new"][0]["items"])
        result["kept"]["items"].append(4)
        result["new"][0]["items"].append(5)
        self.assertEqual(updates, {"new": ({"items": [2]},), "kept": {"items": [3]}})
        self.assertEqual(profile, {"kept": {"items": [1]}})

    def test_empty_dictionaries(self):
        result = merge_profile({}, {})
        self.assertEqual(result, {})
        self.assertIsInstance(result, dict)

    def test_container_and_key_type_validation(self):
        for args in (([], {}), ({}, []), (None, {}), ({}, None)):
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    merge_profile(*args)
        for args in (({1: "bad"}, {}), ({}, {1: "bad"}), ({"ok": 1}, {"ok": 2, 3: 4})):
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    merge_profile(*args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
